svg.aria-label: Gates and cell state of the trained LSTM: unit 1 has the greatest absolute final cell value for the length-16 example generated with seed 999. Gates share a 0–1 color scale; cell state uses its own axis. Values are reconstructed stepwise from saved parameters.
